next.reason: Both make 9x an implementor-defined unsuccessful condition with x defined by the implementor. 1985 'must not duplicate any condition specified for the I-O status values 00 through 49' (every other value it defined); §2023:9.1.13.11 GR1 'shall not duplicate any other condition specified by another I-O status value'.
